payload.title: Correlating two GeoSeries
payload.description: This workflow computes the correlation between two GeoSeries using paleoclimate data. It involves fetching data using SPARQL queries, processing it, and performing correlation analysis.

steps.description: Import necessary libraries for data fetching, processing, and analysis.
steps.title: Import Libraries

steps.description: Set up the SPARQL endpoint URL and define the necessary namespaces for querying the paleoclimate data.
steps.title: Define SPARQL Endpoint and Namespaces

steps.description: Create a SPARQL query to fetch the required paleoclimate datasets from the specified endpoint.
steps.title: Construct SPARQL Query

steps.description: Execute the SPARQL query to retrieve the paleoclimate data.
steps.title: Fetch Data

steps.description: Process the fetched data and convert it into a format suitable for correlation analysis.
steps.title: Process and Convert Data

steps.description: Compute the correlation between the two GeoSeries using the processed data.
steps.title: Perform Correlation Analysis
